name: Talk
overview: Scripture highlights the power and responsibility inherent in our speech, warning that excessive talk often leads to sin while restraint demonstrates wisdom, as Proverbs 10:19 teaches. The Apostle Paul describes the destructive nature of corrupt and malicious speech, including whispering and deceit, which are manifestations of unrighteousness (Romans 1:29). Believers are called to avoid harmful communication and instead speak words that build up and minister grace to others, emphasizing edification as the proper purpose of our talk (Ephesians 4:29).
